support_claim: The packet links similar names and invoicing context but provides no establishing identity evidence (shared legal identifier or explicit mapping) and no establishing distinctness evidence, so the referents remain unresolved.

steps.fact: The identity judgment compares left referent crm:MER-55 against right referent billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
CRM row MER-55 lists the account name as Meridian Energy Partners (no LLC suffix).
Billing records the billed name as Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
No selected observation supplies a shared legal identifier, an explicit MER-55-to-billing mapping, or a packet statement that the CRM account and billed name denote the same legal counterparty.
The relation contract requires establishing evidence for SAME_ENTITY; name similarity and invoice-context association are insufficient to establish identity.
No selected observation establishes that crm:MER-55 and billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC are distinct legal counterparties.
